goal: Second act slice of add-https-aliases: AliasTable + exact-suffix dnsmasq. Implement mjolnir-https-alias:v1 verify (compact JSON, three-line envelope, Ed25519 over domain line + payload) and AliasTable NameTable answering A only from verified records. Collision set retains full owner_pubkey forever; two keys same 16-char label fail closed; highest seq wins; equal seq different payload fail closed; tombstone stops answers but keeps the key. Reuse https_label(). Wire AliasTable into the DNS CompositeTable. reconcile_dnsmasq_uci: if mjolnir.https.mesh_label is set, add exactly `/<mesh-label>.<zone>/127.0.0.1#5335` and rebind `/<mesh-label>.<zone>/` where zone defaults to mesh.worldtree.network; NEVER forward or rebind the parent zone. If mesh_label is unset, add nothing extra. Tests: forged sig, wrong owner for label, parent zone not whitelisted, collision fail-closed, tombstone, golden compact JSON. CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/lm-target. Check the AliasTable/dnsmasq task box. Do not implement issuance, ACME, TLS, or adapter.

anchors.invariant: Alias record bytes, envelope, collision set, fail-closed.
NameTable seam; A-only for this slice; first table that answers wins.
Existing /mesh/ forward+rebind stays; HTTPS suffix is additive and exact.
Reuse https_label; do not fork a second encoder.

acceptance.command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/lm-target cargo test -p mjolnir-mesh https_alias --offline && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/lm-target cargo test -p mjolnir-mesh dnsmasq --offline
criteria: Forged and wrong-owner records do not answer
Parent zone is never forwarded or rebind-exempt
Collision of two owner keys on one label answers neither

out_of_scope.item: Issuance authorization, DNS adapter, ACME, router TLS
